The Archaeologist persona Workflow step 6 references extract-dialogue as an available tool for reading assembled prose from chunk files

Both API surface documentation files (mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md and mcp-server/gui/docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md) list renderChunksToText, handleGetChunkText, and the GET .../chunks/:filename/text endpoint

summary: Verified and completed all documentation deliverables for WP-003. Three of five acceptance criteria were already satisfied by prior work: (1) the Archaeologist persona source already had no '(future)' placeholder and referenced both the CLI script and GUI 'Text Only' tab; (2) Workflow step 6 already referenced extract-dialogue; (3) AGENTS.md already contained the scripts/extract-dialogue.js row after scripts/read-log.js; (4) both api-surface.md files already listed renderChunksToText, handleGetChunkText, and the GET .../chunks/:filename/text endpoint. Two additions were made: added the missing getChunkText frontend API client method to the GUI api-surface.md section 2.1 table, and added a developer note to the Archaeologist persona source reminding developers to run node scripts/build-personas.js after modifying the persona source (AC5).

comments.note: The GUI api-surface.md was missing the getChunkText entry in the 2.1 API client methods table, even though the backend endpoint and renderer were already documented. Added the entry alongside getChunkRendered and getChunkStructured for completeness.

The build-personas.js developer note was placed at the end of the Archaeologist persona source file as a blockquote, which is visible in source but will not appear in the generated persona output — appropriate since it targets developers editing the source, not agents reading the persona.
